LinkedIn.format: Professional paragraph with optional bullet points
LinkedIn.style: Use industry keywords, formal structure, value-driven narrative. Data-driven and authoritative tone.
guidelines: Start with a strong hook related to industry impact
Use 1-2 bullet points for key benefits if space allows

Instagram.format: Short paragraphs with line breaks + 3-5 emojis
Instagram.style: Casual, visual storytelling, conversational. Keep sentences short and punchy.
guidelines: Use 3-5 relevant emojis naturally throughout the text
Keep sentences under 15 words when possible
Use line breaks every 2-3 sentences for readability
Include 3-5 relevant hashtags at the end
Hashtags must be relevant to product and audience

Email.format: Structured with Subject Line, greeting, body, bullet points, CTA, signature
Email.style: Professional yet personable, clear structure, actionable content.
guidelines: Start with compelling subject line (under 60 characters)
Use bullet points for key features/benefits
Subject line must be non-null and included in output
